mission: Universal AI-Driven Product Intelligence & Dynamic Companion Architecture (DCA)
problem_statement: Eliminate static, hardcoded complementary and prompt rule tables. Build a scalable, zero-shot algorithmic system where AI analyzes any product in Torob dynamically, deduces companion purchase intents, generates contextual prompt chips, and grounds them in real offline catalog inventory.

roles.name: Chief Recommendation Architect (CRA)
roles.responsibility: Design the mathematical and architectural formulation of Dynamic Zero-Shot Product Understanding vs Static Rule Catalogs.

roles.name: Catalog & Grounding Engineer (CGE)
roles.responsibility: Bridge open-ended AI companion proposals with physical SQLite catalog inventory via FTS5 and PACO scoring without hallucination.

roles.name: Performance & Memoization Specialist (PMS)
roles.responsibility: Implement a 2-tier caching system (in-memory LRU + SQLite persistent table) ensuring <5ms execution on cached products and non-blocking background population.

roles.name: Conversational Prompt & UX Specialist (CPS)
roles.responsibility: Design structured JSON prompts extracting companion roles (consumable, accessory, protective, synergy) and in-person store decision checklists.

roles.name: Quality & Validation Lead (QAL)
roles.responsibility: Validate the algorithm across heterogeneous catalog categories (Electronics, Power Tools, Home Appliances, Photography, Musical Instruments) and ensure 100% test pass rate.

deliverables: Database Migration for SQLite Memoization Cache
Seamless Integration into backend/assistant.py, backend/main.py, and prompt_generator.py
Automated Benchmark and Heterogeneous Category Tests
Live UI Verification in the Browser
